$comment: Which skills exist. `node TOOLS/skills-link.mjs` links each one into .claude/skills/ (Claude Code only discovers that folder) and copies RULES/*.md into .claude/rules/. Links do not survive cloud sync: the setup hook re-runs the script at every start. The loading mode is NOT here: it lives in each SKILL.md frontmatter (`disable-model-invocation: true` = on demand, zero tokens until invoked). See RULES/skills.md.

$fields.name: directory name under .claude/skills/, and the name the user invokes with /name
$fields.src: path under SKILLS/, may be nested (e.g. 'web/scraping')
$fields.why: one line: why this skill exists and why its loading mode, so the choice survives the person who made it

skills.name: inbox
skills.why: on demand: proposal format and /inbox review; invoked deliberately

skills.name: supervision
skills.why: on demand: read by supervisor, managers and workers when a supervised run starts

skills.name: investigate
skills.why: native: a root-cause method you would not think to look for mid-bug; must trigger on its own before a second guessed fix

skills.name: spec
skills.why: native: framing a fuzzy feature before coding is easy to skip; must trigger on its own

skills.name: qa
skills.why: native: browser QA pass with a runaway guard; triggers on a QA request without the user knowing the name

skills.name: product-design
skills.why: on demand: a visual overhaul is a deliberate decision; long body, zero cost until invoked
